known_risks: 中文：2026-08-07 的第三次隔离对照否定了 0.1.21：包已被 Cemu 正确载入，但仍只有动作表现加速，普通游泳实际路线位移没有明显提升。复盘确认普通游泳走水下分派器状态 9；该状态两条互斥最终积分在 0x028C7E6C/0x028C7FE0 使用由函数入口装入 f31 的共用 0.5，因此旧版按附近常量载入扫描时漏掉了它们。当前候选只把这两条最终乘法等效改为 1.0，并补上 0x028C7B18 的 1.10→2.0 动作标量；不会修改共用入口 0x028C7924。原 3DS #13 也没有修改对应的最终 0.5 积分，所以这三条属于面向 Wii U 实际位移目标的窄范围适配，仍待修后实机验收。 / English: A third isolated comparison on 2026-08-07 rejected 0.1.21: Cemu loaded the pack correctly, but only action-rate acceleration was visible and ordinary-swim route displacement did not clearly increase. Review confirmed that ordinary swimming uses underwater-dispatcher state 9. Its two mutually exclusive final integrations at 0x028C7E6C/0x028C7FE0 use an entry-shared 0.5 loaded into f31, so the old nearby-constant scan missed them. This candidate changes only those two final multiplies to an effective 1.0 and adds the missed 1.10-to-2.0 action scalar at 0x028C7B18; it deliberately leaves shared entry 0x028C7924 untouched. Original 3DS #13 also does not patch the corresponding final 0.5 integration, so these three writes are a narrow Wii U adaptation for actual travel and still await post-fix gameplay acceptance.

中文：只启用本项并关闭 #65，保持 FPS、武器、模拟摇杆幅度、动作与起终点一致；对同一路线计时：基线和启用后各至少三次并比较中位数，同时检查碰撞、转向、上浮/下潜、冲刺与闪避是否过冲。 / English: Enable only this pack and disable #65; keep FPS, weapon, analog-stick magnitude, action, and route endpoints identical. Time the same underwater route for at least three baseline and three enabled runs, compare medians, and also check collision, turning, ascent/descent, dashing, and evasion for overshoot.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #13 转换为 JP v96 PPC；根据三轮 2026-08-07 负向实测，除 0xC7 与动作倍率外，现对普通游泳状态 9 的两条最终积分增加窄范围 0.5→1.0 实际位移适配，并补齐该状态漏掉的 1.10→2.0 动作标量；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #13 to JP-v96 PPC. Following three negative gameplay comparisons on 2026-08-07, it supplements the 0xC7/action-rate mapping with a narrow 0.5-to-1.0 physical-travel adaptation at both final integrations of ordinary-swim state 9 and adds that state's missed 1.10-to-2.0 action scalar; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
